fx.basis: Send IMT (AUD sold to buy USD)

cache_multipliers.basis: multipliers on the model's own input rate, not absolute prices
cache_multipliers.note: Anthropic prices a cache read at ~0.1x the input rate and a 5-minute cache write at 1.25x. Applied to cache_read_tokens / cache_write_tokens, which Anthropic reports separately from input_tokens. OpenAI prompt caching is automatic and charges nothing to write, so its adapter reports cache_write_tokens=0 and the write multiplier never applies to it.
